title: Spice It Up
lines: Spice up your life, mami, pour it on, pour it on
Better too much than to die empty
If I fall ten times, I laugh on twelve
I wasn't born to live on "what if"
Spice up your life, papi, pour it on, pour it on
Memories that precious don't stay hidden
